value.rationale: Nonunique truth-preserving Kripke presentation is a natural mathematical question once closure semantics provides only one canonical model. The all-type multiplicity and arbitrary successor-support orbit formula classifies all presentations modulo genuine isomorphism rather than merely naming their worlds; it captures nontrivial coupled symmetries, yields exact new class-indexed profiles, and separates labelled and unlabelled mathematical invariants. It is not an arbitrary single small example or just the ordinary labelled count. Its reliance on standard Pólya methods and possible broader historical coverage are acknowledged.
